text:
incident-bot: Pager P0 — sustained 429 spike on /v1/embeddings/batch (region: us-west1). Alert rate 280/min, error rate 18% from 22:04 UTC.

Sam (oncall): seeing a big jump in batching callers, looks client-side rate shape overflow + a few large batch jobs eating slots. starting live mitigation.

Priya (sre): can we soften QPS for bulk embedding routes and add a short-lived burst cap? recommend soft-quota lane first to avoid hard failures.

Jules (runtime): agree. rolling a soft throttle at the edge for embeddings batch endpoints. target: reduce concurrent requests to 60% of normal for 15m, then evaluate.

Carlos (sdk): heads up — we'll need to push SDK guidance and a patch to respect Retry-After and expose idempotency helper. ETA 30m for a patch that sets default backoff.

Sam (oncall): action list: 1) apply soft-throttle (Jules) 2) bump embed route quota per-org to clamp bursts (Priya) 3) SDK advisory for retry/backoff and idempotency (Carlos) 4) status banner + CS note (Sam).

Maya-bot: change applied: edge soft-throttle profile "embeddings-soft-2026-03" activated at 22:09 UTC, target concurrency 60%.

Priya (sre): applied provisional org-level quota clamps: orgs with >200 concurrent embed streams moved to 0.6x for 20 minutes. Notifying accounts with highest error counts.

Sam (oncall): customer impact: ~12 customers affected, majority large-batch embedding pipelines. latency up 30% for remaining requests, some 429s still persistent but dropping.

Carlos (sdk): posting recommended client-side mitigation now: short advisory to customers and a small SDK change. Proposed text (publishing here for review):

Carlos (sdk): "If you see 429s on batch endpoints: 1) Honor 429/Retry-After header. 2) Use exponential backoff with full jitter. Recommended: base=1s, max=60s, attempts=6. 3) Add idempotency tokens for non-idempotent batch uploads using X-Idempotency-Key. 4) Reduce default batch size temporarily (e.g., from 256 -> 64) for bulk embedding jobs. SDK 1.2.3 will include helpers and a toggle to auto-shard large requests."

Sam (oncall): please include example snippet for the SDK advisory so customers can copy/paste.

Carlos (sdk): adding snippet:

```python
# SDK: exponential backoff with jitter
import random, time
def backoff(attempt, base=1.0, cap=60.0):
    exp = min(cap, base * (2 ** attempt))
    return random.uniform(0, exp)

# usage
for i in range(6):
    res = client.embed_batch(payload)
    if res.status_code == 429:
        sleep = backoff(i)
        time.sleep(sleep)
        continue
    break
```

Carlos (sdk): and curl example to set idempotency header:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>" \
  -d '{"inputs": [...]}'
```

Priya (sre): small note — make sure SDK respects server-sent Retry-After in seconds and also backoff caps so we don't thundering-herd when throttle lifts.

Jules (runtime): runtime change: enabled quick-fallback to smaller batching kernels for affected workers to reduce per-request memory pressure — will log to admin stream. Expect small lat increase but fewer 429s.

Sam (oncall): communications: pushing a brief banner to dashboard + emailing top 12 affected accounts with recommended mitigations and an ETA update. Carlos, can you prepare the advisory text for CS?

Carlos (sdk): sending draft to #support now. main points: reduce batch size, honor Retry-After, add idempotency, upgrade to SDK 1.2.3 (auto backoff + helper). Also include manual workaround: stagger job restarts with 5-15m offsets.

Sam (oncall): handoff — I'm off in 20m. Priya will take lead for monitoring and escalation after 22:30 UTC. Priya?

Priya (sre): taking handoff. summary: P0 triggered by heavy embedding batchers + memory/slot pressure. mitigations applied: edge soft-throttle, org quota clamps, runtime kernel fallback, SDK advisory + patch queued. continue monitoring 10m windows; if 429 rate > 5% for another 15m escalate storage team (possible KV cache pressure).

Maya-bot: metric snapshot @22:18 UTC: 429 rate 6.2%, alert rate 54/min, avg latency 420ms (was 320ms pre-incident).

Carlos (sdk): uploaded SDK patch branch: sdk/1.2.3/auto-backoff. small change: default attempts=6 -> logs Retry-After if present. ping me for review.

Priya (sre): next steps for oncall: 1) monitor error window for 30m 2) if 429s plateau above 5% after soft-throttle, escalate to runtime + infra for temporary capacity bump 3) schedule a post-incident triage within 48 hours to adjust default batch-size recommendations and add proactive limiters on known heavy clients.

Sam (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes in incident tracker. Priya taking primary. tagging incident-bot to update page and set follow-up task.

incident-bot: Follow-up tasks created: INCIDENT-2345: Postmortem + SDK advisory follow-up; INCIDENT-2346: Add proactive quota heuristics for bulk embed clients.

Priya (sre): quick check-in at 22:28 UTC — 429s down to 3.1%, health improving. keeping soft-throttle for another 10m then start gradual rollback if metrics stay good.

Sam (oncall): good handoff. leaving channel. :thumbsup:

Carlos (sdk): I'll push a patch note and a short FAQ section to SDK docs about idempotency and backoff best-practices.

Jules (runtime): monitoring logs show kernel fallback reduced OOMs on affected workers. will file tuning ticket for kernel thresholds.

Maya-bot: incident thread closed to active paging at 22:40 UTC; monitoring alerts remain.

Priya (sre): closing notes in tracker, will run a 48h follow-up with engineering + SDK + support to lock in mitigations and customer comms.

Carlos (sdk): copied.

Sam (oncall): great job all.
